faqs.answer: AlisnART (Guangdong Alisn Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.) plans, designs, builds and supports four kinds of projects: art installations, stage installations, palace banquet shows and urban renewal. Each project covers lighting, structure, control and maintenance together, so a night-time scene can actually be built and keep running.
faqs.question: What does AlisnART do?

faqs.answer: Art installations: scenic-entrance landmarks, interactive light installations, commercial and festive beautification, hotel arrival spaces and public-art nodes. Stage installations: lake performances, festive stages, mobile parades, water-based self-propelled installations and open-ground linked performance systems. Palace banquet shows: cultural themes, meal-sequence structure, spatial scenography, lighting and sound, performer routing and opening operations support. Urban renewal: ancient-town waterfronts, commercial streets, park squares, continuous wayfinding, public art and modular canopy systems.
